title: Fetch API
description: The native browser API for making HTTP requests.

data.text: The Fetch API is a built-in browser interface for making network requests. It returns promises and provides a more powerful and flexible alternative to XMLHttpRequest.

data.title: Basic GET Request
data.content: Fetch data using the native Fetch API.

data.title: POST Request
data.content: Send data with a POST request.

data.title: Error Handling
data.text: The Fetch API does not throw on HTTP errors. Always check response.ok or response.status before parsing.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Fetch is built into modern browsers
It returns promises and works with async/await
You must handle HTTP errors manually
data.takeaway: The Fetch API is a lightweight, native option for HTTP requests.
